tasks.title: Keep table headers and actions on one line and restore the approved type scale with regression evidence
tasks.spec: ## Repository: console — Behavior, Checks and Completion evidence 1–6; Required behavior R1–R4, Risks, Counterexamples, Security impact and Acceptance evidence (feature). Implement the shared header/action nowrap rules, actions-cell markup and wrapping cell-note prose, the body/h1/h2 scale, and all HTTP/browser assertions together. Preserve existing assertions and constraints; hold with needs-input if an unrelated assertion breaks rather than weakening it.

acceptance.command: bun test src/server.test.ts src/server.checks.test.ts src/server.team.test.ts src/server.tokens.test.ts src/server.probes.test.ts
acceptance.expected: Follow the section's TDD requirement: before the fix, new CSS and action-cell/cell-note assertions fail for the missing rules/markup; after the fix, 0 test failures. Assert the literal CSS substrings and absent font-size: 1.75rem from Checks, the action links within td.actions-cell on all four routes, and the literal This console while retaining the existing strong assertion. A focused run's coverage exit is not its acceptance result; the full coverage gate is bun run check.
Exit 0 with the repository's lint, root/e2e typecheck and full tests green; retain the 0.8 line coverage threshold and paste summary lines in the PR.

Red proof, typography group alone: run the new assertions with src/styles.ts restored locally to 00ef91c, as Completion evidence 2 requires. Exit nonzero with a labeled mismatch for body 16 versus 15 px, h1 28 versus 39.04 px at 1280, or h2 18 versus 23.52 px at 1280. Record the failing message in the PR; local group selection must not be committed.

Separate red proof, action group alone: use the new markup/tests with 00ef91c styles and temporarily skip typography assertions locally. Exit nonzero with a message naming /checks at 1280 px, Actions or an action label, and a measured line count greater than the literal 1. Record this second failure in the PR, then restore final styles and all assertions.

Final tree exits 0. R4 uses document.fonts.ready and Range rect line counting excluding visually-hidden suffixes, with literal expected values in e2e/design-matrix.ts. For light/dark at 1280/390, Checks headers equal [Name, Id, Type, Target, Source, State, Last result, Actions], each at 1 line; long-url has exactly [View, Edit, Export, Delete], each at 1 line. At 390 the row's Actions cell is inside the box within 0.5 px after assertChecksBoxEnd. Body/h1/#people-heading sizes are 15/39.04/23.52 px at 1280 and 15/32/20 px at 390 within 0.01 px; h1 line-height is 42.944/35.2 px and letter-spacing -0.7808/-0.64 px within 0.05 px; h1/h2 weights are 700/500. Other tables match their literal R4 header lists: Sessions [Signed in, Last used, empty] measures 1/1/0 lines; other headers and Team member/invite, Tokens and Probes action links measure 1 line at the specified existing harness widths. Tokens has more than 0 Rotate links; Probes has more than 0 of each Rotate this token and Revoke this token. Print labeled ok lines for these checks. Preserve axe, 0 CSP violations, 0 other-origin requests, fonts, colors, assertFits, assertNoSidewaysScroll, all assertChecksBoxEnd checks including the 2 px outline, check-detail checks, hostile text, 1-line email and shell geometry. Report any changed literal and change it only when required by this spec.

Only paths in the console section's Files list change. PR evidence includes this scope check; no token values, routes, roles, forms, stored data, dependencies, root font size or component-specific heading sizes change, as required by Non-goals and Security impact.
Exit 0 with no diff: dependencies, lockfile and CSP implementation are unchanged.

Fixture service starts; manually open /checks at 1280 px and confirm View Edit Export Delete each occupy 1 line and the page title is approximately 39 px. Report the command and observed result in the PR per Completion evidence 5 and console AGENTS.md.

The console PR's check, docker, deploy-dev and browser CI jobs are green, as required by Acceptance evidence (feature). The existing deploy-dev job supplies the Compose end-to-end check; do not change deploy or weaken CI.

PR body names #777 and Closes lorenzh/pulse-meta#<child> using the actual child issue number, lists checks run and known limits, and records Completion evidence 1–5: full-check summaries, both distinct red messages, final browser success for the required schemes/widths/tables, scope/unchanged-file evidence and the manual smoke result. State Security impact: no consistently with the spec.
